name: Promenade (Rock) Beach
notes: 1.2 km seafront promenade. Closed to vehicles 18:00-07:30, which is exactly when it is worth walking. Rocky, not a swimming beach.

name: French Quarter (White Town) walk
notes: Mustard-yellow colonial streets - Rue Dumas, Rue Suffren, Rue Romain Rolland. Best light before 09:00.

name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
notes: Silence is enforced. No phones or cameras inside. Modest dress.

name: Manakula Vinayagar Temple
notes: Temple elephant Lakshmi is often out front in the mornings.

name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
notes: Gothic revival, stained glass panels of Christ's life. Avoid Sunday mass hours unless attending.

name: Immaculate Conception Cathedral
notes: One of the oldest churches in the city, white and brown facade. Closed midday roughly 12:00-15:00.

name: Pondicherry Museum
notes: Roman-era finds from Arikamedu, Chola and Pallava sculpture, French colonial furniture. Closed Mondays and national holidays.

name: Bharathi Park & Aayi Mandapam
notes: Shaded square around the white Aayi Mandapam monument. Good with kids.

name: Botanical Garden
notes: 22 acres, established 1826. Toy train and aquarium on site - the reason to bring kids.

name: Goubert Market (Big Bazaar Street)
notes: Working produce and flower market. Loud, wet underfoot, best before 09:00.

name: White Town boutiques (Kasha Ki Aasha, Hidesign, Auroville stores)
notes: Handmade paper, incense, leather, Auroville-made goods. Most shut by 18:30. Kasha Ki Aasha itself is closed Wednesdays.

name: Matrimandir Viewing Point, Auroville
notes: Free pass from the Visitors Centre, issued daily 09:00-17:30. A short walk or free shuttle takes you from the Visitors Centre to the Viewing Point. Viewing point only - the inner chamber needs a separate booking made at least 3 days ahead and is closed Tuesdays and Sundays.

name: Auroville Visitors Centre
notes: Exhibition, video theatre, craft boutiques and a cafeteria. This is also where Matrimandir passes are issued.

name: Serenity Beach
notes: Actual sand, unlike Promenade. Surf shacks and cafes behind it. Best at sunrise.

name: Surf lesson at Serenity Beach
notes: Beginner lessons run about 2 hours including board, at any of several schools clustered on Serenity Beach (Kallialay, Mother Ocean, Guru Surf). Book a day ahead in season. Swell is best roughly July-September.

name: Paradise Beach via Chunnambar Boat House
notes: Reached only by backwater ferry from Chunnambar, about 8 km south of town. Last outbound ferry is 16:00 - miss it and you are stuck. Boat house itself runs 09:00-18:00. Budget 3-4 hours door to door.

name: Eden Beach (Blue Flag)
notes: Blue Flag certified, clean sand, lifeguards and changing rooms. About 8 km south.

name: Auroville Beach
notes: Quieter than Serenity. Strong currents - not a great swim for weak swimmers.

name: Ousteri (Oussudu) Lake
notes: Wetland bird sanctuary about 10 km west. Migratory birds roughly November-February. Early morning or it is just a hot lake.

name: Arikamedu Roman trading site
notes: 2,000-year-old Indo-Roman port ruins on the Ariyankuppam river. Sparse and unrestored - for people who actually like ruins. Entry is free at most reports, though a nominal ticket is mentioned by some sources - carry small change just in case.

name: Scuba diving (Temple Adventures)
notes: India's east-coast dive base. The Discover Scuba (pool and sea) package runs about a day including briefing, pool session and a boat/ocean dive. Book ahead. Visibility is best roughly February-April and September-October.

name: Backwater kayaking, Chunnambar
notes: Mangrove backwaters behind the boat house. Calmer and cheaper than the sea options. Roughly Rs 800/hour per person; longer packages cost more.

name: Morning yoga session (Auroville / Serenity)
notes: Drop-in classes at several Serenity and Auroville studios (e.g. Serendipity Auroville charges around Rs 300 for a drop-in Hatha class). Walk-ins usually fine, message ahead in season.

name: Heritage cycle tour of the Boulevard town
notes: Covers both the French and Tamil quarters. Far better than doing White Town twice on foot. Local operators run this for well under half the price of premium foreign-currency booking platforms - shop around.

name: Sunset at Rock Beach & Gandhi Statue
notes: The whole town turns out here after 18:00 when the road closes to traffic. Street food carts along the stretch.

name: Rooftop bar / live music night
notes: Alcohol is notably cheaper here than in Tamil Nadu, which is half of why weekenders come. Most rooftop bars wind down between 22:30 and midnight; a few close earlier around 22:30.

name: Bharathiyar Memorial Museum
notes: The house where the Tamil poet Subramania Bharati lived in exile. Closed Mondays.

name: Veerampattinam fishing village & beach
notes: Working fishing village. Boats come in early morning. Be respectful with the camera.

name: Pichavaram mangrove forest (day trip)
notes: World's second-largest mangrove forest, about 2 hours south (near Chidambaram). Only worth it on a 3-day trip - it eats an entire day. Entry and rowboat together run roughly Rs 500-700pp; the 1200-1500 estimate mainly covers shared taxi/cab for the round trip.

name: French War Memorial
notes: War memorial on Goubert Avenue built 1937-38, inaugurated by Governor Crocicchia in 1938, honoring French Indian soldiers of WWI; illuminated on Bastille Day (14 July).

name: Old Lighthouse
notes: Built 1836 by engineer L. Guerre, decommissioned in 1970 when a new lighthouse was built; 29m fluted tower opposite the Gandhi Statue, now used as a small museum/viewpoint.

name: Statue of Dupleix
notes: Statue of Joseph Francois Dupleix, Governor-General of French India, commissioned in 1870; stands in a seaside park at the southern end of Goubert Avenue.

name: Saint Joan of Arc Statue
notes: Marble statue and seafacing square on Dumas Street, opposite Notre Dame des Anges Church, donated to the parish by French industrialist Francois Gaudart in February 1920.

name: Notre Dame des Anges Church
notes: Built by Louis Guerre in 1855 on Dumas Street; fourth oldest church in Puducherry, known for white limestone-and-eggshell facade; masses held in French, Tamil and English.

name: Varadaraja Perumal Temple
notes: Believed to be Pondicherry's oldest temple, dating to circa 970 AD with inscriptions from Rajaraja Chola's reign (1014-37 CE); sheltered idols of Vedapureeswarar Temple after its 1748 destruction by French troops.

name: Vedapureeswarar Temple
notes: Chola-era Shiva temple destroyed by French troops in 1748 during Hindu-Christian riots; rebuilt in 1788 by Divan Kandappa Mudaliar with public contributions; has a five-tiered rajagopuram.

name: Kamatchi Amman Temple
notes: Over 500-year-old temple on Bharathi Street dedicated to Goddess Durga/Kamakshi; hosts the ten-day Chitra Pournami Kinnarath Brahmotsavam festival.

name: Ananda Ranga Pillai Mansion
notes: 1735 mansion of Ananda Ranga Pillai, dubash to Governor Dupleix, whose diaries record 18th-century Pondicherry life; only the ground floor is open to visitors, on Ranga Pillai Street opposite the Grand Bazaar.

name: Raj Nivas
notes: Official residence of the Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry, opposite Bharathi Park; French-Indian architecture with monolithic pillars brought from Gingee Fort in 1751. Viewed mainly from outside; interior access requires prior clearance.

name: Romain Rolland Library
notes: Established 1827 as Bibliotheque Publique, renamed after French writer Romain Rolland; largest library in the Union Territory with roughly 335,000 books, near Raj Nivas and Promenade Beach. A genuinely quiet, air-conditioned reading hall with desks and seating -- a solid pick if you want somewhere calm to sit and work or study for a couple of hours.

name: Gandhi Statue (Rock Beach)
notes: Statue of Mahatma Gandhi inaugurated 26 January 1965, sculpted by Roy Choudhary, surrounded by eight 300-year-old granite pillars brought from Gingee Fort in 1866; sits opposite the old pier on Rock/Promenade Beach.

name: French Institute of Pondicherry (IFP)
notes: Research institute inaugurated 20 March 1955; library holds ~70,000 books and 8,400 palm-leaf manuscripts. Gardens/exterior are freely visitable; library/manuscript access needs prior researcher permission.

name: Alliance Francaise de Pondicherry
notes: French cultural centre in a colonial villa on the southern edge of the Promenade; hosts monthly exhibitions, film screenings and concerts, and has a library, auditorium and garden restaurant.

name: Puducherry Science Centre and Planetarium
notes: Also known as Dr. Abdul Kalam Science Centre and Planetarium, First Cross Road, Lawspet; closed Mondays. Separate tickets for science centre and planetarium show.

name: Mission Street Boutiques
notes: French Quarter shopping street lined with boutiques including Anokhi (hand-block printed textiles), Casablanca (home decor) and Kalki (Auroville-made clothing); typical item prices Rs 200-2,000.

name: INS Cuddalore Underwater Museum (Temple Reef)
notes: India's first underwater museum: a decommissioned Indian Navy minesweeper scuttled roughly 7km offshore at about 26m depth as an artificial dive reef; visited via certified scuba dive trip, not open to snorkelers/walk-ins.

name: Chunnambar Boat House
notes: Boathouse on Cuddalore Road at Nonankuppam, ~8km from Puducherry, on the Chunnambar backwaters; entry Rs 15/adult (Rs 5 for children 4-8). Motor, speed, sail, row and pedal boats available; also the departure point for the ferry to Paradise Beach.

name: FFC Arena - Cricket & Football Turf
notes: Cricket and football turf ground in Morattandi near Auroville; artificial turf with floodlights for night play.

name: K7 Sports Hub
notes: Multi-sport turf hub in Lawspet offering box cricket, football (5-a-side), volleyball, handball and one-sided basketball; floodlit artificial turf.

name: Eagle Turf
notes: Football and cricket turf on Vazhuthavur Road, Kurumbapet; bookable via Playo/Playspots; artificial turf with floodlights.

name: HTZee - Hitterz Turf Zone
notes: Box cricket and football turf near Mahatma Gandhi Medical College; artificial turf ground with floodlights, bookable via Playspots app.

name: SRC Turf
notes: Box cricket/football turf at MSR Garden, Moolakulam, opposite East Coast Hospital; floodlit artificial turf.

name: AR Sports-Verse
notes: Cricket/football turf on ECR Main Road, Chinnamudaliarchavadi, near the Auroville/Serenity Beach corridor; floodlit artificial turf.

name: Unity Park Turf
notes: Cricket/football turf ground on ECR Main Road, Lawspet; floodlit artificial turf.

name: Hotel Le Royal Park Pool
notes: Hotel has two outdoor pools including a kids' pool; sky-view ellipse main pool is 15.5m long. Day-guest access typically arranged with F&B minimum spend; verify current rate by phone.

name: Prince Park Farm House Pool
notes: Day-pass swimming pool package with lunch included; Rs 500 adults, Rs 250 children under 12; outdoor farmhouse-style pool.

name: Anandha Inn Convention Centre & Suites Pool
notes: Hotel outdoor swimming pool with adjoining fitness studio; day-guest access available on request, confirm current pricing directly with hotel.

name: Puducherry Swimming Center (Murungapakkam)
notes: Public/coaching swimming centre at Villianur Road, Murungapakkam; guest day entry Rs 200 for adults and children; also offers coaching batches and memberships.

name: Sands Point Hotel Pool
notes: Hotel outdoor swimming pool listed among Pondicherry hotels with pools; day-pass terms not published online, confirm directly.

name: Golden Bridge Pottery
notes: India's first ceramic studio, founded 1971 by Deborah Smith and Ray Meeker; offers introductory pottery sessions and longer courses. Prior appointment recommended.

name: Kallialay Surf School
notes: Surf school at Serenity Beach, Kottakuppam, founded 2009; group/private lessons, foam boards for beginners; multi-day courses available.

name: Guru Surf School
notes: Surf lessons at Serenity Beach, Kottakuppam; group lessons ~60-75min, private ~60min; foam surfboards for beginners; multi-day course discounts.

name: Standup Paddling - Pondicherry Backwaters
notes: SUP through calm mangrove backwaters roughly 10-15 minutes from White Town; instructor-led; swimming ability required; early morning slot only.

name: Kitesurfing - Paradise Beach area
notes: Kitesurfing offered seasonally at Paradise Beach with operators including Scubarasta, Kallialay Surf School and Mother Ocean Surf School; wind-dependent, best in seasonal wind windows.

name: ATV Ride - Chunnambar
notes: Quad bike/ATV rides available at the Chunnambar Boat House area and beach; pricing varies by operator/ride length; safety gear and brief training provided.

name: Red Earth Riding School
notes: Full equestrian centre in Auroville on 22 acres, ~30 horses; dressage arena, jumping arena, cross-country course. Best season Oct-Mar.

name: S-CAPE BOX Escape Room
notes: Puducherry's escape room venue at Braminal Street, Mudaliarpet, established 2017; multiple themed rooms.

name: Lotus Badminton Club
notes: Indoor wooden-floor badminton courts in Bharathi Nagar, Lawspet; hourly court hire plus coaching for all ages.

name: Global Sports Badminton Court
notes: Indoor badminton facility in Krishna Nagar, Lawspet; hourly court rental plus membership and coaching options.

name: Sri Angalamman Rental Bicycle
notes: Bicycle rental shop on Mission Street, White Town; hourly, daily and weekly rental options for exploring the heritage French Quarter.

name: Rock n' Bubbles Rock Climbing
notes: Semi-artificial climbing wall facility in Auroville; teaches knots and climbing technique, sessions from 2 hours to week-long workshops; ages 7-77.

name: SS Tennis Academy
notes: Tennis academy and court hire in Pondicherry offering coaching and casual court rental for various age groups; outdoor hard courts.

name: Go-Karting Pondicherry (Pogo Land)
notes: 350-metre go-kart track, part of Pogo Land amusement park; ~10-minute drive session. Open to children above 12 driving solo.

name: Le Cafe (on the Promenade)
notes: Open 24 hours, right on the seafront. The default sunrise coffee. Service is slow - factor it in.

name: Baker Street
notes: French bakery. Croissants, quiche, eclairs. Gets a queue by 09:00 on weekends.

name: Surguru (pure veg South Indian)
notes: Cheap, fast, reliable. Ghee roast and filter coffee. The local default, not a tourist one.

name: Cafe des Arts
notes: Courtyard cafe in a colonial house - the most photographed one in town. Closed Tuesdays.

name: Coromandel Cafe
notes: Leafy garden setting in a restored heritage building. Reserve on weekend evenings.

name: Villa Shanti
notes: Courtyard dining, live music some nights. The nicest sit-down dinner in White Town.

name: Sea Gulls Restaurant
notes: Multi-level sea-facing terrace. Seafood and a bar. Go for the view more than the food.

name: Bread & Chocolate (Auroville)
notes: Organic, mostly vegetarian, strong vegan options. The right lunch stop if you are already at Auroville.

name: Tanto Pizzeria
notes: Wood-fired pizza near Serenity Beach. Closed Mondays at some branches - worth a call-ahead check as reports vary by location.

name: Hotel Anandha Bhavan
notes: Banana-leaf meals for the price of a coffee in White Town.

name: Kasha Ki Aasha rooftop cafe
notes: Terrace cafe above a craft shop. Good breakfast, doubles as a shopping stop.

name: La Maison Rose
notes: Pink colonial villa, French-Mediterranean menu, boutique attached.

name: Bay of Buddha (rooftop)
notes: Rooftop with a sea view, Pan-Asian menu, full bar. Dinner only - no lunch service. Doubles as the night spot.

name: Auroville Bakery
notes: Sourdough, cinnamon rolls, cheap and good. Cash is easiest. Closed Sundays.

name: Gelateria Montecatini Terme
notes: Italian-run gelato. The reliable 16:00 heat-break. This refers to the White Town branch; the separate Auroville-area branch has closed down.

name: L'Aqua Sea View Lounge
notes: Rooftop-adjacent bar at Ajantha Sea View hotel, 50 Goubert Ave, White Town; sea-facing lounge, casual drinks menu.

name: Flaming Dragons Lounge & Nightlife
notes: Chinese-themed rooftop lounge on La Bourdonnais St, White Town; cocktail-forward menu, panoramic rooftop views.

name: Catamaran Brewing Company
notes: Pondicherry's first microbrewery, 3rd floor above Westside, Anna Salai; freshly crafted craft beers plus veg/non-veg food menu.

name: WTF - Way To Fly Restopub
notes: 3rd floor, Chetty St, Heritage Town; full bar, DJ, dance floor, rooftop seating; ranked #1 pub in Pondicherry by a local listing site.

name: Toxic Rooftop Pub
notes: Rooftop pub inside Hotel Atithi, SV Patel Salai, Heritage Town; rooftop views, lively evening crowd.

name: Pub Zipper
notes: Open-air bar with spacious dance floor on Maraimalai Adigal Salai, near Bus Stand, Pudupalaiyam.

name: Cosy Resto Pub
notes: Rooftop pub on Anna Salai, Raja Rajeswari Nagar, Heritage Town; energetic DJ sets and dance floor, one of the later-closing venues in town.

name: Heist Nightlife
notes: Two-floor venue on SH49 near Lawspet; rooftop open until 11:30pm and indoor nightclub with DJ/dance floor until late; arranges taxi service for female guests.

name: The Lighthouse
notes: Rooftop restaurant at The Promenade on Goubert Avenue overlooking the Bay of Bengal; known for seafood and continental dishes.

name: Cafe Xtasi
notes: Small wood-fired pizza joint in White Town; known for thin-crust pizzas and spaghetti aglio olio.

name: Zuka Chocolate Cafe
notes: Dessert and chocolate cafe near Goubert Avenue/Mission Street known for handmade chocolates, cakes, pastries and Belgian hot chocolate.

name: Rendezvous Cafe Restaurant
notes: Colonial-style restaurant near Palais de Mahe on Rue Bussy serving continental, seafood and South Indian fusion; popular terrace seating.

name: Satsanga
notes: Restaurant set in a former French villa on Rue Labourdonnais serving French and European cuisine including steaks and crepes; garden courtyard seating.

name: Carte Blanche
notes: In-house restaurant of the heritage Hotel de l'Orient on Rue Romain Rolland; classic French, Indian and Creole menu in a colonial courtyard.

name: Naturellement Garden Cafe
notes: Garden cafe attached to Naturellement's organic bakery in Auroville; farm-to-table salads, breads and desserts; closed Mondays.

name: Indian Coffee House
notes: Heritage cooperative-run coffee house on Nehru Street known for filter coffee, dosa and waiters in cockade caps; iconic budget breakfast institution.

name: The Indian Kaffe Express (TIKE)
notes: Bistro on Rue Dumas near Eglise Notre-Dame des Anges combining Indian fast-food classics with continental crepes and salads.

name: Kailash Parbat
notes: Pure-vegetarian chain outlet at the Mission Street/Montorsier Street junction; known for chaat, Sindhi-style thalis and North Indian vegetarian fare.

name: Le Club
notes: One of Pondicherry's oldest restaurants (opened 1988), inside Hotel De Pondicherry on Dumas Street; French, Continental and Indian menu. Some directories flag this listing as closed, so confirm current operating status before visiting.

name: Cafe de Flore
notes: Small courtyard cafe inside Alliance Francaise on Rue Dumas; known for Nutella crepes, pasta and burgers; closed Mondays.

name: La Terrasse
notes: Casual multi-cuisine restaurant near Bussy Street known for a wide variety of wood-fired thin-crust pizzas alongside continental and North Indian dishes.

name: Solar Kitchen
notes: Auroville's central solar-powered community dining hall; visitors should book ahead. Payment via Aurocard or a token from the guest centre; vegetarian communal meals.

name: Farm Fresh
notes: Popular pizza/continental restaurant on Auroville Main Road near Kuilapalayam, opposite Auroville Bakery; garden seating.

name: Sri Ganesh Bhavan
notes: Budget vegetarian mess on Cuddalore Main Road in Nainarmandapam/Mudaliarpet; inexpensive local spot for South Indian tiffin, lunch and dinner.

name: Chez Francis
notes: Fine-dining restaurant on Rue Romain Rolland serving French-South Indian fusion; signature Creole prawn curry.

name: Villa Helena
notes: In-house restaurant of the 19th-century Villa Helena heritage guesthouse on Bussy Street; Continental/Italian/French menu; reviews note the ambience outshines the food quality.

name: Les Alizes
notes: Rooftop fine-dining restaurant at the Palais de Mahe (CGH Earth) hotel; French-Creole and Indo-European cuisine with a strong seafood focus.

name: Marc's Cafe
notes: Cafe and bakery on Auroville Main Road known for fresh breads, pastries, breakfast fare and coffee.
